messages:
ash: Starting region-by-region rollout now — US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Warm pools prepped. Will hold between region transitions for capacity + latency checks.

mike: ack. any special pinning for EU?

jen: EU needs model pin for compliance test. Use `redwood-open-2.7-quant` for EU only, flow for US/EU identical except model name.

ash: noted. deploy-bot, kick off US with version v1.8.2 and set holdpoint after US succeeds.

deploy-bot: START: rolling out v1.8.2 -> region=us-west-2 (wave 1/3)
```
cmd: deploy --version v1.8.2 --region us-west-2 --warm 40 --hold-after wave
status: provisioning warm pool (requested 40)
```

jen: smoke check (pre-traffic): CPU 68%, GPU mem 62%, KV-hit 27%, warm pool ready 38/40. baseline p50=38ms p95=210ms.

mike: good numbers. set automated guard: if p95 > 450ms for >3m -> rollback. If error-rate >1% -> rollback.

ash: agreed. also enforce token-cost spike detection: >1.5x baseline for 5m -> pause.

deploy-bot: UPDATE: us-west-2 wave complete. traffic switched -> 10%->50%->100% per plan. Post-switch metrics: p50=44ms p95=220ms errors=0.6%. HOLD at wave boundary awaiting EU manual approval.

jen: US looks healthy. backing up config and snapshotting KV caches. Snapshot id `snap-2026-03-21-usw2-01`.

ash: manual approve for EU? remember we must pin EU to `redwood-open-2.7-quant` and run the compliance smoke (latency + golden-set eval).

mike: approving EU rollout. I'll watch the golden-set eval.

deploy-bot: START: rolling out v1.8.2 -> region=eu-west-1 (wave 2/3)
```
cmd: deploy --version v1.8.2 --region eu-west-1 --model redwood-open-2.7-quant --warm 30 --hold-after wave
```

jen: EU pre-traffic capacity check: warm pool 22/30, infra quotas available, baseline p50=60ms p95=300ms. golden-set eval queued.

sre-bot: ALERT: apac-quotas low — warm pool target for ap-southeast-1 might be delayed (~+15m) if we allocate more to EU. Current free GPUs in APAC: 6.

ash: thanks for the heads up @sre-bot. do not borrow APAC capacity. EU proceed but keep APAC untouched. If EU needs >80% of global spare, we pause and re-evaluate.

deploy-bot: EU wave switched to 40% traffic. golden-set results: 98.6% match rate, p95=310ms (within tolerance but close).

mike: golden-set 98.6% OK. But p95 drifting up. let's be ready to pin rollback if p95 > 380ms for >5m.

jen: EU warm pool scaled to 28/30 to stabilize tail latency. KV-cache primed.

deploy-bot: EU wave complete. Status: success. APAC queued (wave 3/3) — manual approval required due to quota note from @sre-bot.

ash: do not proceed to APAC until warm pool >= 80% of target or we have explicit sign-off from infra. We will not degrade APAC customers.

sre-bot: UPDATE: apac capacity increase scheduled +12m (spare GPUs +18). Warm pool target 40 -> will reach 34/40 in ~13m. ETA 13m.

mike: OK. fallback plan if not ready: route apac traffic to `v1.7.9` pinned pool in ap-southeast-1 with traffic-split 80/20 until warm pool hits 80%. That keeps latency predictable.

ash: implement fallback routing if warm pool < 32 after 14m. Notify ops channel if fallback triggers.

jen: noted. I'll monitor the thermal telemetry and KV cold miss rate. If fallback triggers, I'll snapshot logs and prepare rollback notes.

deploy-bot: QUEUED: APAC wave (waiting approval).

ash: releasing minimal release notes now — linking in #release-notes: https://redwood.internal/release/v1.8.2/short-notes (contains model pinning for EU + rollback thresholds).

mike: I'll stay on watch for the next 30m. If APAC warms on time we proceed; otherwise we fallback as planned.

jen: TL;DR: US ok, EU ok (p95 close), APAC pending warm pool. Rollback rules and fallbacks set.

ash: thanks team. will update once APAC warm confirms or fallback kicks in. :railway_track:
